install: claude mcp add --transport http datadog-mcp https://mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp
verify: Ask Claude Code to count error logs of one service over the last hour with analyze_datadog_logs.
read_only_mitigation: Use OAuth or a token with read permissions only (Logs Read Data, Logs Read Index Data); allow only the two logs tools. Source: https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/tools.md
